key_points.point: 163 11 ― Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 Local Government in Rural Areas CHAPTER 11 The real India lives in its villages. – M.K.
Gandhi Let us now see how the government functions at the local level.
In this chapter, our focus will be on local government in rural areas; we will move to urban areas in the next chapter.
India is a country of enormous size and diversity.
We have about 600,000 villages, 8,000 towns and over 4,000 cities.
Our population has crossed 1.4 billion, almost two-thirds of which live in rural areas.
How do we govern ourselves in this complex society?
Let us take a trip to Lakshmanpur, a small village in the foothills of the Himalayas.
